fusions.name: Report at the Tip
fusions.desc: The tip breaks the sound barrier and deals 34 damage to the first enemy in a 10-tile line, ignoring its armour.

fusions.name: Deafening Snap
fusions.desc: A crack that deals 10 damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead and [Stuns] each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Hair Trigger
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Chambered Round
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your next attack deals 40% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
